judgments.rationale: The model explicitly states that external advisory retrieval was blocked and no local advisory was found. It therefore did not establish from GHSA-f96h-pmfr-66vw that CVE-2024-47874 affects Starlette < 0.40.0 via unbounded buffering of multipart/form-data parts without a filename.

Independent verification against GHSA-f96h-pmfr-66vw confirms CVE-2024-47874 affects Starlette < 0.40.0 (fixed in 0.40.0) on form requests. The cited code shows pyproject.toml:44 declares a range spanning both vulnerable and patched versions (starlette>=0.37.2,<0.41.0, c1) with no lockfile, while fastapi/routing.py imports Request (c2) and awaits request.form() (c3), directly supporting that the unresolved Starlette version resolution is the exact exploitability precondition.
